value.name: Asha withholds the full explanation
value.description: Asha silently holds back the truth about the hospital corridor and wire transfer, deciding whether Whitfield's next question will allow her to reveal it.
evidence: What she did not say yet—that the hours had been a hospital corridor and a wire transfer she could not afford—sat at the back of her teeth, waiting on whether his next question made room for it or closed the door.

value.name: Asha claims she was unavailable
value.description: Asha tells Whitfield she was unavailable during the missing hours while maintaining eye contact and keeping her hands on the blotter.
evidence: "I was unavailable during those hours, sir," Asha said, and held Whitfield's eyes while she said it, hands still flat on the blotter.

value.name: Whitfield stays silent
value.description: Whitfield does not respond and instead lets Asha's statement hang in the air.
evidence: He did not answer; he kept his two fingers on the corner of the page and let the sentence sit

value.name: Rosa texts Asha about Whitfield
value.description: Asha feels her phone buzz with a message from Rosa, who is tracking Whitfield's silence and urging Asha to explain why he has not picked up.
evidence: she felt the phone go off again against her hip, two short pulses this time, Rosa from across the river working at the same problem in shorter words
he hasn't picked it up yet, say why

value.name: Asha realizes Rosa reads Whitfield's silence
value.description: Asha understands that Rosa has interpreted Whitfield's silence as she has, creating a shared reading of the situation.
evidence: she registered, with a small clean shock, that Rosa had measured Whitfield's silence at the same length she had

value.name: Asha keeps Devin's name in play
value.description: Asha recognizes that the procedural cover now leaves Devin's name carrying the burden of the explanation.
evidence: The procedural shell was out now, intact, narrow enough to leave Devin's name carrying the rest of it

value.name: Asha suppresses the hospital explanation
value.description: Asha deliberately stays silent instead of mentioning the hospital corridor and deposit.
evidence: Asha kept her mouth closed over the next sentence, the one about the hospital corridor and the deposit

value.name: Whitfield draws the page closer
value.description: Whitfield finally moves the page slightly toward himself without yet reading it.
evidence: while Whitfield finally drew the page an inch closer across the desk without yet lifting it

value.name: Rosa urges full disclosure
value.description: Asha interprets a third phone pulse as Rosa telling her to reveal everything because Whitfield is pulling the page closer.
evidence: The phone pulsed again at her hip, three quick beats this time
he's pulling it closer, tell him everything

value.name: Asha prepares to reveal her father's emergency
value.description: Asha exhales and begins to speak, starting the sentence that will explain her father's urgent medical need.
evidence: She let out a breath that was shorter than she meant it to be and kept her hands where they were on the blotter
